scope: state dictionary recomputed from the two raw sources; the registered definition of every count is stated with the number

definitions.calibratedZeroCells: cells in the 37 log10-calibrated columns where the calibration workbook records concentration exactly 0; the stored value of such a cell is the log10 floor code log10(min(positive)/2), not 0
definitions.linearCalibratedZeros: the 33 linear-calibrated columns also contain calibrated zeros; they are reported separately and are NOT counted as floor codes, because 0 is a plausible measured concentration there
definitions.floorColumns: uncalibrated columns whose minimum stored value equals -1.81781854 within 1e-06
definitions.floorCells: cells equal to the estimated floor value (median of the per-column minima) within 1e-06, summed over the floor columns

notResolved: a repeated floor code is a convention, not proof of a measured zero or of a detection limit; no LOD is declared in the attachments
calibrated negative concentrations are reported in calibratedNegativeCells; their origin is not established here and no value was clipped
